messages.content: Name three primary colours.
Red, blue and yellow are the primary colours of paint.
What is the capital of Portugal?
Lisbon is the capital of Portugal.
How many days are in a leap year?
A leap year has 366 days, one more than an ordinary year.
What gas do plants take from the air?
Plants take carbon dioxide from the air and give back oxygen.
Which ocean is the largest?
The Pacific is the largest and deepest ocean.
What is 12 times 12?
12 times 12 is 144.
Who wrote Pride and Prejudice?
Jane Austen wrote Pride and Prejudice.
What is the boiling point of water at sea level?
Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius at sea level.
Name the largest planet.
Jupiter is the largest planet in the solar system.
What does HTTP stand for?
HTTP stands for Hypertext Transfer Protocol.
How many strings does a violin have?
A violin has four strings.
What is the smallest prime number?
Two is the smallest prime number.
Which country invented paper?
Paper was invented in China.
What is the chemical symbol for gold?
The symbol for gold is Au.
How long is a marathon?
A marathon is 42.195 kilometres long.
What is the hardest natural material?
Diamond is the hardest natural material.
Who painted the Mona Lisa?
Leonardo da Vinci painted the Mona Lisa.
How many continents are there?
There are seven continents.
What is the freezing point of water in Fahrenheit?
Water freezes at 32 degrees Fahrenheit.
Which language has the most native speakers?
Mandarin Chinese has the most native speakers.
What is a group of wolves called?
A group of wolves is called a pack.
How many sides does a hexagon have?
A hexagon has six sides.
What is the speed of light?
Light travels at about 299792 kilometres per second in a vacuum.
Which metal is liquid at room temperature?
Mercury is liquid at room temperature.
What is the square root of 81?
The square root of 81 is nine.
Who discovered penicillin?
Alexander Fleming discovered penicillin.
What is the longest river in Africa?
The Nile is the longest river in Africa.
How many bones are in the adult human body?
An adult human body has 206 bones.
What does CPU stand for?
CPU stands for Central Processing Unit.
Which gas makes up most of Earth's atmosphere?
Nitrogen makes up most of Earth's atmosphere.
What is the capital of Canada?
Ottawa is the capital of Canada.
How many minutes are in a day?
A day has 1440 minutes.
